title: Coral and the Garden
author: Ada Kavanagh
blurb: Jude Winterbourne, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
